span.p:
own = operand[3:0]
in = own[1], push = own[0], field = own[3:2]
in_pin = own[3:2], bit = own[3:1], level = own[0]

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 440px; text-align: center;

span.p:
control
cycles = 1 + delay
halted = pc == N
issue = !halted & counter == 0
stall = issue & (FIFO & (push ? rx_full : tx_empty)
| WAIT & gpio_in[in_pin] != level)
last = issue ? delay == 0 : counter == 1
skip = SKIP & in_shift_reg[bit] == level
counter reg, 5 bits, rst → 0
issue & !stall → delay
counter > 0 → counter − 1

span.p:
pc_skip = skip
(pc + 1 + pc_skip: over the next word)

(one pin-write port: SET and every side effect)
